rows.en: Could you all go and take a look for me?
You can get there from "Random Cube" on the menu. I'm counting on you!
Seravee was lookin' for you lot, y'know? Got himself in a right old panic, he did.
Is it really okay for me to stay here?
Of course it is.
Thaaank youuu~ Then I'll help out with something.
Let's see... In that case, there's an untouched storeroom next door. Could you clean it up for us?
Easy peasy~
Kanegon happily left the Briefing Room.
And then...
Hey! Something crazy's happened to the storeroom next door!
Huh? But Kanegon was supposed to be cleaning it up for us.
This is way past "cleaning." The whole inside's been completely changed.
Wait, what do you mean?
Ehehehehe...!
Did you build that? What the hell is that place even for?
You don't know? It's called a casino. The "Kanegon Casino"!
A casino...!?
I wanted to be useful to everyone, so I thought really hard about it, y'know?
Fighting all the time wears you out, right? When it does, you unwind at the casino!
Anyway, come check it out!
The "Kanegon Casino" was added.
Kyaaaaaaah!!
What's going on!!
A kaiju...!!
What!? A kaiju in our base!?
Hey! Just leave it to me!! What kinda bastard are we talkin' about!?
I-Its mouth is bigger than its face... It has tiny eyeballs on the tips of its antennae...
A big, pudgy belly... And there was some kind of counter on its chest.
What the heck is that? I can't even picture it. Sounds way too fishy!!
Wait for meee~~~!!
Here it comes...!! It followed me here!!
I'm not anybody suspicious~
Kanegon!!
...Y-You know who I am!?
Yeah, you're Kanegon, the Coin Monster, right? You're famous.
Phew, what a relieeef~
Huh? So it's not an enemy!?
Kanegon, how did you get here?
I dunnooo~ When I woke up, I was just here.
I see... It's most likely the same as with us.
Hey, is it okay if I stay here?
What!? A high-energy reading!? The particle cannon!!
Gwaah...!!!
A direct hit!?
Back at base, the injured Gundams went straight into the medical room.
Hikari, Methuss and Kamen Rider 2 were busy repairing the facilities hit by enemy fire.
You did great!!
Yeah... But it cost us Seravee.
I heard Seravee's "voice" too. I have a rough idea of what happened, but...
...And just then!
I've lost my physical body, but my consciousness has merged with Veda.
Seravee!!
There's no need to grieve. I was a being created by Veda in the first place.
More importantly, let's talk about what comes next.
Just as Belial said, the final Cube lies beyond the Veda Cube.
It's called the "Genocide Cube." A Cube that exists for the sole purpose of exterminating heroes.
Inside it, kaiju, kaijin and mobile suits are being revived by all sorts of methods.
Can you tell us anything specific?
...I'm combing through the data now. There's an enormous amount of it, after all.
...Also, there's one more thing that concerns me.
What is it?
Part of Veda has been rewritten by someone.
What did you say!?
That makes no sense!
With Reborns dead, nobody but Seravee should be able to access Veda, right?
It should be that way... and yet, here it is...
...But what is this? I sense an unfathomably deep darkness from this area...
You mean there's still someone else behind Belial and the rest!?
Probably... I'll try to take control of that area somehow. I need a little time.
Either way, Veda is out of our hands.
What we can do is go to the Genocide Cube and defeat the enemy.
Belial...!!
And Shadow Moon...!!
I'll pass on information as it comes in, too. I may have lost my body, but my heart is with you all!!
Of course it is!
Same goes for us. Even when we're apart, our hearts are with you.
We're counting on you!!

notes.note: 0925 per 0925.bla: #0.4-0.5 Hikari (labels correct). 'Omae-tachi' -> 'you all'.
Kintaros per 0926.bla. Seravee g=m.

0927, 0928 and 0929 are referenced by no event script (no 0927/0928/0929.bla), so speakers cannot be recovered; they look like unused draft/variant tables. 0927 = variant of the 0916 Kanegon scene (story_184): identical lines reuse the story_184 English. Speakers inferred: Kanegon #0.1,3,5,15,17,19-21,36,39,41,43,46,48; Methuss #0.2,4,12,14,28,30,33,34,37; Hikari #0.31,45.
Ankh in the 0916 version (#0.11,13,16,18); reused that English.
System line; phrased like 'An Item Search function was added...' (story_185). Kanegon Casino per UI glossary.

In this draft the responder is rough-spoken (soitsu-a, yarou, nanda-a) and does not know Kanegon, unlike Mebius in 0916; reads like Momotaros (Den-O Sword Form). Same voice for #0.35 and #0.44. Guess.
Calm speaker who recognises Kanegon (likely Hikari or an Ultra); 'Coin Monster' as in story_184.
Kanegon g=n -> 'it'.
Unlabelled; likely Hikari (ore, calm). Subject restored as 'it' (Kanegon's situation).
Source is a single full-width space (blank box). Kept as one space.
0928 rows copy 0625 (story_116) #0.25/26/29/30; English reused verbatim. Speakers there: Zoffy, unlabelled, Hikari, unlabelled.

0929 = unscripted draft of the post-Veda base scene (cf. 0930 in story_188). Speakers inferred: Seravee (speaking through Veda) #0.7,9-13,15,16,18,22,23,25,30. #0.3 is a base member (Hikari/Methuss/Rider 2) greeting the returning team; #0.4 a returning hero. Kept speaker-neutral.
'Gisei ni natte shimatta' -> 'it cost us Seravee' (not 'died': #0.7 reveals he merged with Veda).
Speaker uses watashi; plausibly Zoffy or Rider 1 at base. Dropped subject of 'haaku shite iru' restored as 'I'.
MS = mobile suits; kaijin per glossary (revived kaijin).
Rough speaker (#0.20-21 one person). Reborns per glossary.
Source typo (dare ka ru = dare ka iru); read as 'someone is'.
'Kanchi dekinai' = we can't involve ourselves in Veda -> 'Veda is out of our hands'.
Answer to Seravee's 'my heart is with you'.
'Tanonda ze': speaker asks Seravee to keep supporting them -> 'We're counting on you' (group context; 'I'm' also possible).
